title: How far do the new links reach?
hook: An original cue tree links known material to new items; every link takes one hop.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to distinguish a reachable association from evidence that an association was learned

misconception: Adding links to a diagram necessarily creates useful, memorable knowledge.
objective: Distinguish a reachable association from evidence that an association was learned.

claims.text: Learning How to Learn; Barbara Oakley, Terrence Sejnowski and Alistair McConville; 2018.
claims.source: Candidate bibliographic record for learning-link-new-to-2018; edition and original publication year require independent authoritative checking. No book source was opened by this drafter.

claims.text: Learning How to Learn encourages connecting new material with what a learner already knows.
claims.source: Learning How to Learn (2018), candidate original-language edition; relevant chapter/section unconfirmed, not supplied or fabricated. Proposed attribution in our own words; fact-checker must open the book before publication.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: Two hops; no cycles or overlaps; at most ten distinct nodes; all edges equally traversable; root counts as known cue. Exact network inputs [{"label": "One link onward", "values": [10, 1, 2]}, {"label": "Two links onward", "values": [10, 2, 2]}]; second author arithmetic check A=3, B=7. One-link branches reach {A}; two-link branches {B}. Added outgoing links expose more descendants within two hops.
claims.source: EDD-010-books-100-models.md formula; this brief fixes invented inputs, not sampled people or measured outcomes. Independent arithmetic recomputation recorded in answerCheck. All displayed labels, hook and prediction premises are scenario conventions. Round only display to two decimals when necessary.

claims.text: Does it hold up? Reachability does not establish comprehension, recall, or useful associations.
claims.source: Scope boundary: a deterministic toy establishes only the disclosed arithmetic. Book-specific empirical evidence has not been assessed; source-access hold remains. No invented study, effect size or replication verdict.
